mechanism: Both drugs are antimalarials that can cause similar adverse effects (hemolysis in G6PD deficiency, retinopathy, QT prolongation) and may compete for hepatic metabolism via CYP3A4/CYP2D6.
action: Monitor for additive toxicity including hemolytic anemia, retinal toxicity, and cardiac arrhythmias; ensure G6PD screening before use; consider dose optimization or alternative agents if combination is necessary.
